diagnostics.message: :resource.null_resource.file_permission must wait for :resource.local_file.private_ssh_key before running chmod; a shared filename variable does not order file creation. The source contains depends_on, but this edge is absent from the supplied graph; ensure it is retained in the effective configuration.

module.runner:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance can launch its runner before module.runner:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ssm grants SSM access. When token management is enabled, order instance startup after this attachment so bootstrap can read/write the registration token.

module.runner:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance must wait for module.runner:resource.aws_ssm_parameter.runner_registration_token: user data manages this parameter's value, so concurrent Terraform creation with the initial null value can race with bootstrap.

When CloudWatch logging is enabled, module.runner:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance should wait for module.runner:resource.aws_iam_role_policy.instance so the logging agent has its permissions at startup; the instance-profile reference only orders role creation, not this policy.

When logging is enabled, module.runner:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance should wait for module.runner:resource.aws_cloudwatch_log_group.environment before launching the logging agent. The logging template uses the environment string rather than a reference to the managed log group, leaving startup unordered.
